result.instructions: Tools for Sendspark, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show me our Dynamic Video campaigns and how many prospects each one has."; "Which prospects in the Q3 Outbound campaign have an errored video?"; "Add jane@acme.com to the Q3 Outbound campaign, with the company Acme.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Sendspark data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run sendspark_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run sendspark_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run sendspark_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. sendspark_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: sendspark_get_workspace_id
tools.title: Get workspace id for the API key
tools.description: Return the workspace id that the configured API key belongs to. Use this id in the other tools. Calls GET /v1/workspaces/identifier.

annotations.title: Get workspace id for the API key

tools.name: sendspark_list_workspaces
tools.title: List workspaces
tools.description: List the workspaces that the signed-in user can access. Calls GET /v1/workspaces.

tools.name: sendspark_list_dynamic_campaigns
tools.title: List dynamic video campaigns
tools.description: List the Dynamic Video campaigns of one workspace, with optional search, sort and paging. Calls GET /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/dynamics.

workspaceId.description: Workspace id. Get it from sendspark_get_workspace_id or sendspark_list_workspaces.

search.description: Only campaigns whose name matches this text.

projectionType.description: How much of each campaign to return.

tools.name: sendspark_get_dynamic_campaign
tools.title: Get a dynamic video campaign
tools.description: Get one Dynamic Video campaign: its name, template settings and status. Calls GET /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/dynamics/{dynamicId}.

workspaceId.description: Workspace id. Get it from sendspark_get_workspace_id or sendspark_list_workspaces.

tools.name: sendspark_get_dynamics_settings
tools.title: Get dynamic video settings
tools.description: Get the Dynamic Video settings of a workspace, such as the available options for new campaigns. Calls GET /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/dynamics/settings.

workspaceId.description: Workspace id. Get it from sendspark_get_workspace_id or sendspark_list_workspaces.

tools.name: sendspark_get_prospect
tools.title: Get a prospect in a campaign
tools.description: Get one prospect of a campaign by the prospect's email: video status and engagement data. Calls GET /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/dynamics/{dynamicId}/prospects/{contactEmail}.

workspaceId.description: Workspace id. Get it from sendspark_get_workspace_id or sendspark_list_workspaces.

contactEmail.description: The prospect's email address, as stored in the campaign.

include.description: Comma-separated extra fields to include: emailEmbedHTML, fields.

annotations.title: Get a prospect in a campaign

tools.name: sendspark_get_transcript_status
tools.title: Get video transcript status
tools.description: Check whether a campaign video has a transcript and whether it is ready to read. Never starts a transcription. Calls GET /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/campaigns/{campaignId}/transcript/status.

workspaceId.description: Workspace id. Get it from sendspark_get_workspace_id or sendspark_list_workspaces.

campaignId.description: The campaign id of the video.

tools.name: sendspark_get_transcript
tools.title: Get a video transcript
tools.description: Read the transcript of a campaign video as JSON, or as a WebVTT or SubRip subtitle file. Reading never starts a transcription. A transcript that is not ready returns not found: check sendspark_get_transcript_status first. Calls GET /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/campaigns/{campaignId}/transcript.

workspaceId.description: Workspace id. Get it from sendspark_get_workspace_id or sendspark_list_workspaces.

campaignId.description: The campaign id of the video.

tools.name: sendspark_list_webhooks
tools.title: List webhooks
tools.description: List the webhooks of one workspace: the URLs that Sendspark calls on video events. Calls GET /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/webhooks.

workspaceId.description: Workspace id. Get it from sendspark_get_workspace_id or sendspark_list_workspaces.

tools.name: sendspark_get_webhook
tools.title: Get a webhook
tools.description: Get one webhook of a workspace by id. Calls GET /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/webhooks/{webhookId}.

workspaceId.description: Workspace id. Get it from sendspark_get_workspace_id or sendspark_list_workspaces.

tools.name: sendspark_create_dynamic_campaign
tools.title: Create a dynamic video campaign
tools.description: Create a new, empty Dynamic Video campaign with a name. Prospects are added with sendspark_add_prospect. Calls POST /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/dynamics.

workspaceId.description: Workspace id. Get it from sendspark_get_workspace_id or sendspark_list_workspaces.

tools.name: sendspark_add_prospect
tools.title: Add a prospect and generate its video
tools.description: Add one prospect to a campaign and generate its personalized video. Can use paid video credits: processAndAuthorizeCharge defaults to false and must be true only when the user agreed to that charge. Calls POST /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/dynamics/{dynamicId}/prospect.

workspaceId.description: Workspace id. Get it from sendspark_get_workspace_id or sendspark_list_workspaces.

contactEmail.description: Prospect email. Must be unique within the campaign.

contactName.description: Prospect name, used in the video.

company.description: Prospect company, used in the video.

jobTitle.description: Prospect job title, used in the video.

customField.description: Free-text field for the campaign template.

processAndAuthorizeCharge.description: Default false. Set true only when the user agreed to the charge for videos above the plan limit.

callbackId.description: Your own id for this request, echoed back by Sendspark.

annotations.title: Add a prospect and generate its video
